# `pygeovision postprocess`

Turn a model's classification raster into delivered products: remove specks, vectorise, smooth, regularise building
outlines, compute statistics and accuracy, export, and convert to Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF.
Guide: [Postprocessing](../../data/postprocessing.md).

## When to use it

Use it after inference and before sharing results.

## What you get

A new raster or vector file per command, with the path printed; `class-stats` and `accuracy` print tables.

## Things to know

* Areas are measured in the file's CRS: use a projected (metre) CRS, or the numbers are in degrees
  ([units and CRS](../../data/postprocessing.md)).
* `sieve` changes the map; keep the unsieved raster.
* `accuracy` compares against a reference raster on the same grid.

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Postprocess model predictions — vectorise, smooth, statistics, export.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  accuracy     Compute accuracy metrics vs a reference raster.
  class-stats  Print per-class pixel count and area statistics.
  cog          Convert a GeoTIFF to Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF.
  export       Export vector to GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage, or KML.
  regularise   Regularise building footprints: snap near-axis-aligned edges to the...
  sieve        Remove small patches from a classification raster.
  smooth       Smooth vector polygon boundaries.
  vectorise    Vectorise a classification raster to GeoJSON polygons.
  zonal-stats  Compute per-zone raster statistics.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess accuracy`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess accuracy [OPTIONS] PREDICTION_PATH REFERENCE_PATH

  Compute accuracy metrics vs a reference raster.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess accuracy pred.tif ref.tif --class-names Background,Building,Road

Options:
  --class-names TEXT  Comma-separated class names.
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess class-stats`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess class-stats [OPTIONS] PREDICTION_PATH

  Print per-class pixel count and area statistics.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess class-stats prediction.tif

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess cog`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess cog [OPTIONS] INPUT_PATH

  Convert a GeoTIFF to Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess cog prediction.tif --output prediction_cog.tif

Options:
  --output TEXT
  --help         Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess export`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess export [OPTIONS] INPUT_PATH

  Export vector to GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage, or KML.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess export buildings.geojson --output buildings.gpkg --format gpkg

Options:
  --output TEXT                   [required]
  --format [geojson|shp|gpkg|kml]
                                  [default: geojson]
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess regularise`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess regularise [OPTIONS] INPUT_PATH

  Regularise building footprints: snap near-axis-aligned edges to the building's dominant
  orientation.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess regularise buildings.geojson --output regular.geojson

Options:
  --output TEXT     [required]
  --min-area FLOAT  [default: 10.0]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess sieve`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess sieve [OPTIONS] INPUT_PATH

  Remove small patches from a classification raster.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess sieve pred.tif --min-pixels 10

Options:
  --min-pixels INTEGER  [default: 10]
  --output TEXT
  --help                Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess smooth`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess smooth [OPTIONS] INPUT_PATH

  Smooth vector polygon boundaries.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess smooth buildings.geojson --output smooth.geojson --tolerance 0.5

Options:
  --output TEXT      [required]
  --tolerance FLOAT  [default: 0.5]
  --help             Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess vectorise`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess vectorise [OPTIONS] INPUT_PATH

  Vectorise a classification raster to GeoJSON polygons.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess vectorise pred.tif --output buildings.geojson --target-class 1 --min-area 50

Options:
  --output TEXT           Output GeoJSON path.  [required]
  --target-class INTEGER  Only vectorise this class.
  --min-area FLOAT        Minimum polygon area in m².
  --simplify FLOAT        Douglas-Peucker tolerance.
  --validate
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision postprocess zonal-stats`

```text
Usage: pygeovision postprocess zonal-stats [OPTIONS] RASTER_PATH VECTOR_PATH

  Compute per-zone raster statistics.

  Example:
      pygeovision postprocess zonal-stats ndvi.tif fields.geojson --output stats.geojson

Options:
  --output TEXT  [required]
  --stats TEXT   [default: mean,std,min,max,count]
  --help         Show this message and exit.
```
